source.title_or_label: Character proportion for pixel-art platformers (16x32 sprites)

technique.name: Pixel-art character proportion for platformers
technique.summary: Author platformer characters around a 16x32 sprite proportion of roughly 3-4 head heights, with a clear baseline/feet placement, deliberate visual margin distinct from the hitbox, and silhouette coherence with the 16x16 tile grid.

minimum_required_before_canonical: visual fixture showing the proportion at 16x32 in a real scene
baseline/feet contract reconciled with the collision hitbox
runtime screenshot or VDP dump for any visual-quality claim
current_gaps: source is direct text analysis with example C code, not a local runtime fixture
no visual fixture or baseline contract exists yet

promotion_decision.rationale: The proportion guidance strengthens existing art and collision owners; it is recorded as candidate backlog and the expansion is deferred to Phase 4.

accepted_concepts: A 16x32 sprite proportion of roughly 3-4 head heights is a workable platformer character baseline.
Baseline/feet placement must be explicit so the character sits correctly on tiles.
Visual margin around the sprite is distinct from the collision hitbox and must not be conflated with it.
Character silhouette and proportion must stay coherent with the 16x16 tile grid.
rejected_or_deferred_claims: The example C code in the attachment is illustrative and does not become a canonical API.
Correct proportion does not by itself prove AAA quality.
Direct text analysis does not prove runtime behavior; no testado_em_emulador, validado_budget or ready_for_aaa is implied.
required_followups: Expand the existing owner skills (character-design, sprite-animation, megadrive-pixel-strict-rules, collision-system-architect) in Phase 4.
Create a visual fixture or baseline contract before promoting this guidance to production.
